title: Malicious code in @pkgship/frps-windows-amd64 (npm)
description: The npm package @pkgship/frps-windows-amd64 version 0.71.1 contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a different, secure machine. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee eradication of the malicious software, as full control may have been given to an external attacker.
